body: This is because of how we track locks for pg_locks: we have ObjectLockTracker at the TSLocalLockManager level, instead of querying ObjectLockManager directly. This approach is incompatible with shared memory fastpath locking, which loads locks directly from PG to ObjectLockManager, skipping TSLocalLockManager.
